nextStoryContext: US-005 (group D) closes the sequential A/B/C/D integration-tier Bun.sleepSync migration for this PRD (CAM-305): all 4 named files (ensure-worker-pane-selfheal.test.ts 5 sites, sendkeys-submit.test.ts 3 sites, plan-runner-target-obey.test.ts 3 sites, plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts [integration-tier] 3 sites) were found ALREADY migrated in the working tree at session start (uncommitted, from an apparently interrupted prior attempt at this exact story -- confirmed via the staged scripts/file-size-budget.json _ref, which already carried a 'US-005, CAM-305: raise test/integration/sendkeys-submit.test.ts 69->72' entry matching the exact diff present). This session verified the pre-existing diff was complete and correct rather than re-doing the work: all 14 sites use waitForCondition polling a genuine observable (isPaneAlive/has-session/capture-pane-content), zero bare-sleep tracker-ref suppressions needed, `grep -rn 'Bun.sleepSync(' test/integration/` returns 0 hits repo-wide. Ran the full verification chain fresh: bun run typecheck (0 errors), bun test test/integration/{4 files} (7 pass/0 fail), bun test full suite (4591 pass/0 fail), bun run check:all (all 12 gates ok, no new ratchet raise needed beyond the already-staged sendkeys-submit.test.ts file-size entry). Appended a 'Group D' bullet to patterns.md mirroring the A/B/C bullets' style, then committed exactly the 4 test files + file-size-budget.json + patterns.md (left the unrelated pre-existing behavioral-gate.test.ts working-tree diff untouched, see openQuestions). This PRD's named integration-tier sleep migration (54 sites across A+B+C+D) is now fully complete; whatever the next PRD story is, it is NOT part of this sequential arc unless it explicitly reopens the out-of-scope non-integration-tier sites listed in openQuestions.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.spawnSync is the blocking/synchronous counterpart to Bun.spawn, spawning a fresh process per call and returning a SyncSubprocess snapshot (stdout/stderr as Buffer, exitCode, success). No restriction against calling it repeatedly in a loop. This validates the group D pattern of polling has-session/display-message/capture-pane via repeated Bun.spawnSync calls inside a waitForCondition predicate -- each poll tick is a fresh, correct synchronous subprocess call, not a stale/cached handle.
